closure_rationale: Engine contract, interface, rule schema, fidelity instrumentation, and test plan are complete. OPEN-L3-1 (concrete rule content) and OPEN-L3-2 (predicate evaluation failure policy) remain OPEN but do not block the Batch 1 contract-design closure — they block full prototype completion (Batch 2+) and engine implementation respectively. Four bounded repairs applied (see repair_record).

repairs: Repair 1 — Closure-status contradiction resolved: report-batch1.md was OPEN while specification was CLOSED. Both now CLOSED. Boundary: Batch 1 = contract design; OPEN-L3-1 blocks full prototype completion, not contract-design closure.

Repair 2 — F3 assertion corrected: removed rule_set_id identifier-change requirement. Replaced with state-correspondence semantics: rule_set_bound_for_state == S_new; ConclusionTypes(RS_used) ⊆ A_AI(S_new). Two empty RS states sharing rule objects do not false-fail F3.

Repair 3 — Predicate evaluation failure: removed the 'exception → rule does not fire → continue' policy as an established fact. OPEN-L3-2 introduced. Permitted behaviour until resolved: episode reports failure; no unsupported advisory emitted.

Repair 4 — ConfigurationError / FidelityTrace contract: resolved contradiction between 'propagates to caller' and 'trace always emitted'. Introduced EpisodeResult{advisories, trace, error} as the return type. All three guarantees (failure observable, trace obtainable, no advisory emitted) now coherent.

predecessors: JOURNAL 1 ALGORITHM SPECIFICATION AND COMPLEXITY ANALYSIS CLOSED — ALGORITHM 3 COMPLEXITY AND AUTHORITY RESIDUE REPAIRED (design/journal1-algorithm-specification)
